tei:div.tei:p: (179)rang nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs rin po che 'chong gur phub pa 'dra ba'i dbus su nyi ma'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog smug nag rgyan dang phyag mtshan spang pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing gi mthar e ring mthing gas bskor ba/ ljags steng du padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du hrī dmar po la e ring dmar pos bskor ba/ spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po la e ring dkar pos bskor bar bsam/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng lu gu rgyud du sku'i dbyibs brgyud g.yas su bskor zhing steng du 'od dkar mthing la dmar shas che ba 'phros mgrin pa'i sngags phreng la thim nas dmar la dkar shas che ba 'phros mgrin pa'i sngags phreng la thim nas dmar la dkar shas ce ba steng du 'phros nas zhal nas byung shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs spyi bo'i sngags 'phreng la thim nas yang 'od zer sngags kyi phreng ba byung shangs bug g.yas pa nas byung zhal nas zhugs ye shes sems dpa'i/ shangs bug g.yas pa'ang zhal du zhugs nas thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng thim par bsam/ yang (180)'od zer 'phros rgyal ba rnams mchod/ byin brlabs dngos grub thams cad sku phyag rgya gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ka'i rnam par sgo gsum la thim pas rang nyid zil gnon gyi sku gsung thugs su gyur pa'i gang nas
